title: Hanzo AI
description: Settings for the Hanzo AI in-notebook assistant.

apiKey.title: Hanzo API key
apiKey.description: Your Hanzo `hk-` API key (from https://hanzo.ai). Leave blank to use the gateway's public/limited models. Sent as a Bearer token to api.hanzo.ai; never stored in source.

model.title: Default model
model.description: The default model id used for cell actions and the assistant panel. Pick any id returned by /v1/models.

baseUrl.title: Gateway base URL
baseUrl.description: The Hanzo AI gateway origin. Override only for a self-hosted gateway.
